title: Symmetry Identities Beyond Renormalization-Group Methods
exact_target: Can exact identities from symmetries give control over models beyond the reach of standard renormalization methods?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003669 (OWR-15960-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Reflection Positivity (2017), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/55, pp. 3263--3343. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 26.
Speicher, Bi-Free Probability and Reflection Positivity (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
OWR Report 55/2017 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: No particular model, identity or estimate is fixed by this research programme. A valid result must state the nonperturbative model class and information obtained, rather than asserting that every symmetry identity solves a difficult model.
